invam3.note: s101: long fine leaf blade, braided leather and beads at the socket, the long butt spike that tells it from the common spear (similarity 0.26)

invam4.note: s202: needle head over a stop disc with the braided wrap just under it, as described; the grey shaft keeps it apart from the pike's pale wood (similarity 0.23)

invam5.note: s404: three barbed heads at staggered heights over small leather rings, a rope binding apart from the javelins' leather wrap; no flags (similarity 0.29)

invbar.note: s101: one crescent blade on the left, its point above the shaft, fixed at the socket and at its tail, a bevelled edge (similarity 0.26)

invbrn.note: s101: one long centre spike, two short thin side spikes at its base, grip and butt cap; s202 shadow-flagged (similarity 0.19)

invbwn.note: s101: one long leg bone, two dark leather wraps, finger-bone charms on a cord; reads as a bone wand at 1x (similarity 0.33)

invcst.note: s202: the dull stone shows in its cage of curled roots at 1x; s303's head is a tangle with no stone, s404 grew antler-like prongs (0.41) (similarity 0.36)

invglv.note: s101: a broad knife blade a third of the length on a light shaft, apart from the leaf spears at 34 px; SH0.02 is grey steel, no residue on a grey ground; s303/s404 are in the review band (similarity 0.28)

invgsc.note: s101: the upright sun disc with short blunt rays round a boss, as described, iron-banded shaft, ball foot; s202-s404 grow spikes that read as a morning star at 1x (similarity 0.36)

invgwn.note: s202: a jawless skull facing out, lashed on a crooked root stick with a grey cloth grip; no shadow flag (similarity 0.28)

invjav.note: s404: three warm-wood javelins, leaf heads at staggered heights, one leather binding; s202's shafts go grey, s101/s303 shadow-flagged (similarity 0.34)

invlst.note: s303: pale ash pole, cord-bound top under a small domed cap, grip near the foot, iron ferrule, the lowest score; s101 is over the line (0.451), s202/s404 in the review band. The shaft is ivory, not white (1x p95 ~200, the grade's ceiling) (similarity 0.37)

invob1.note: s202: clouded crystal held by three bronze talons on a carved grip, as round 2's (similarity 0.21)

invob2.note: s101: milky stone globe, a gilt girdle, a small cross finial, a turned grip; s404's crossing half band sits nearer the original's banded globe (similarity 0.28)

invob3.note: s202: pale smoke wisps in grey glass, a pointed soot-black iron cup, wooden grip (similarity 0.22)

invob4.note: s303: an oxblood sphere half closed in four bronze leaves like a bud, a slim leather grip (similarity 0.19)

invob5.note: s202: violet sphere with a swirl, held by curling roots on a crooked root handle bound with copper wire, iron ferrule (similarity 0.20)

invpax.note: s101: crescent axe left, toothed hammer right, top spike, butt spike, one shaft; s202 and s303 grew a second shaft (P2), s404 is in the review band (similarity 0.27)

invpik.note: s303: a small leaf point that still reads at 1x on the long pale shaft; s101's needle head belongs to the maiden pike (similarity 0.19)

invpil.note: s101: long thin iron shank, square riveted collar, wooden lower half, no flags; s202-s404 are in the review band (similarity 0.36)

invscp.note: s202: an open crown of bronze points round the grey stone over a bead collar, as described; s303's points splay into a star (similarity 0.31)

invscy.note: s404: the blade sweeps out to the right and down from the snath's top, hand peg and grip; s101 (heel block), s202 and s303 (blade both ways) read as pickaxes (similarity 0.23)

invspr.note: s101: willow-leaf head, grip wrap, butt cap; the four seeds are near identical (similarity 0.21)

invspt.note: s303: long centre blade with two flat wings at its base; s101 hangs a ring at the butt, s202 shadow-flagged (similarity 0.23)

invssp.note: s101: broad flat triangular head on a short stout dark shaft. All four seeds sit in the review band, but it is the class: s101 scores higher against the pilum's and throwing spear's originals (0.49, 0.49) than its own; the side by side is a wide flat triangle on a plain socket against the original's narrow leaf on a long metal socket (similarity 0.42)

invtsp.note: s303: the only seed with the harpoon's single backward barb; the others are plain spears (s101 over the line, 0.471). Its 0.42 is the class (0.43 against the short spear's original, 0.42 against the glaive's); dark shaft, leather bands and a narrow head are not the original's; SH0.04 is grey steel, no residue on a grey ground (similarity 0.42)

invvou.note: s101: a tall cleaver flush along the right of the shaft, slanted point above it, back spur, two rings, a bevelled edge; s202's top splits into a V (similarity 0.15)

invwsc.note: s101: a narrow curved blade standing up in line with the shaft, its tip curving forward, ringed socket, two grips (similarity 0.16)

invwsp.note: s202: six notched flanges round the core with a spike finial read as a flanged head at 1x; s101/s303 came out cross-shaped, s404 a drum (similarity 0.16)

invwst.note: s303: a clean crescent of two horns on a round boss over a ringed socket; s202's plate and s404's broad horns read as an axe (similarity 0.25)

invywn.note: s303: a forked yew wand bound under the fork and at the grip, a carved bead on a thong (similarity 0.24)
